sketch_0 = cq.Workplane(plane_0).rect(80, 50)
result = sketch_0.extrude(10)

plane_1 = cq.Plane(origin=(0, 0, 10), normal=(0, -1, 0), xDir=(1, 0, 0))
height_1 = 22
profile_1 = cq.Workplane(plane_1).polyline([(0, 0), (17, 0), (11.5, height_1), (0, height_1)]).close()
solid_1 = profile_1.revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
result = result.union(solid_1)

plane_2 = cq.Plane(origin=(0, 0, -1), normal=(0, 0, 1))
sketch_2 = cq.Workplane(plane_2).circle(7)
result = result.cut(sketch_2.extrude(50))

plane_3 = cq.Plane(origin=(0, 0, -1), normal=(0, 0, 1))
width_3 = 10
sketch_3 = cq.Workplane(plane_3).pushPoints([(-30, 0), (30, 0)]).slot2D(24, width_3, 90)
result = result.cut(sketch_3.extrude(12))
